steps.name: Save an itinerary
steps.do: Build and **Finish** an itinerary with some animals.

steps.name: Backdate visit day
steps.do: In a terminal at the repo root, run `npm run backdate:itinerary`.
steps.expect: Terminal prints that the itinerary date was backdated to yesterday.

steps.name: Trigger past-date recovery
steps.expect: **Itinerary Date Has Passed** appears with **Clear** and **Choose New Date**.

steps.name: Choose new date
steps.do: Click **Choose New Date**, pick an allowed visit date, then **Finish**.
steps.expect: **Choose a New Visit Date** runs; itinerary saves for the new date.

steps.name: Alternate clear path
steps.do: Save another itinerary, run `npm run backdate:itinerary` again, hard-refresh **Itinerary**, then click **Clear**.
steps.expect: Itinerary clears to the empty panel; the builder does not open.

steps.name: Save a summer itinerary
steps.do: Build and **Finish** an itinerary on a peak-summer visit date (e.g. a day in **July**). Include **Warthog** and **River Hippopotamus**, and add **Splash Island** on **Add Attractions**.
steps.expect: Summer itinerary saved with those animals and **Splash Island**.

steps.name: Backdate summer visit
steps.expect: Terminal prints that the itinerary date was backdated to yesterday.

steps.name: Recover onto midwinter
steps.do: Hard-refresh **Itinerary**, click **Choose New Date**, pick a midwinter date (e.g. a day in **January**), then **Finish**.

steps.name: Review seasonal removals
steps.do: In **Itinerary Updated**, open **Animals Removed** and attractions sections.
steps.expect: **Warthog** and **River Hippopotamus** are listed under **Animals Removed**; **Splash Island** is listed as unavailable on the new date.

steps.name: Keep vs remove
steps.do: Use **Keep** / remove choices where offered, then accept the popup.
steps.expect: Choices apply to the recovered itinerary.

steps.name: Coherent winter result
steps.do: Inspect list / Day Planner after accepting.
steps.expect: Visit date is the midwinter day; kept or removed items match the choices from step 10.
